title: Improve Windows filesystem reliability, safe error reporting and native NTFS verification.
changes: Permit get_file_info to read metadata for ordinary Windows files held open without read sharing by another process; still refuse a symbolic-link leaf.
Reject Windows copy_file operations that target the same file through differently cased path strings, preserving source contents.
Explain missing paths, invalid parent-directory paths and exhausted disk quotas; distinguish safe not_found, busy and resource_exhausted telemetry classes without storing file paths.
Add native Windows CI coverage for Unicode and spaced paths, listing, metadata, reading, hashing, copying, missing targets and exclusive file locks.
Make macOS privacy-path helpers and permission-fixture tests portable across the Windows test runner; retain normal file-access and OS permission guards.
Carry forward the published v0.2.210 package-copy audit and Smithery documentation cleanup, preserving the verified client/runtime release-pair invariant.
